meta.selection: cost-aware, tau=0.001 on P(team contains) in bo3_1760 or bo1_0

classification_rules.DATA_ONLY: no function-valued keys anywhere (incl. secondary/self/owned condition); references only core conditions brn/par/psn/tox/slp/frz/confusion/flinch
classification_rules.DATA_PLUS_COMMON: every function is a parametric template shared by >= 3 legal entities (e.g. type-resist berries, mega stones, Surge setters, Protect wrapper), and/or it sets a named volatile/side/slot condition, pseudo-weather, weather or terrain whose handlers are counted once under 'condition'
classification_rules.CUSTOM: at least one bespoke function (template shared by < 3 legal entities)
